subject: Service upgrade & renewal — capacity, premium SLA, and term options
messages:
From: Elena Rivas <elena@starwave.ai>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 10 Feb 2026 09:14:00 -0800
Subject: Renewal conversation — capacity + SLA requirements

Hi Priya,

Hope you're well. Our renewal with Redwood is coming up on Mar 15 and I'd like to align on two items ASAP so we can finalize our internal budget and procurement timeline:

1) Committed capacity increase — we expect a 2x increase in peak tokens and are targeting a move from 4 dedicated GPUs to 8 (or equivalent committed throughput).
2) Premium SLA / latency targets — for our real-time inference path we need a 95th pct latency target (inference-only) under 120ms for typical 512-token requests and a supported escalation path for incidents.

Can you share what Premium Support looks like (on-call, 30-min escalation, SLOs, etc.), impact on pricing for the committed capacity increase, and whether you can accommodate a 6-month canary before committing to a multi-year term? I'm attaching our usage snapshot for Q1 to help sizing.

Attachments: starwave_usage_q1_2026.xlsx (spreadsheet, 120KB)

Thanks — want to get this on the calendar early next week.

Best,
Elena
Head of Platform
Starwave, Inc.

---
From: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Rivas <elena@starwave.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 11 Feb 2026 09:20:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Renewal conversation — capacity + SLA requirements

Hi Elena — thanks for the clear ask and the usage snapshot. Looping in Ben (sales) and Vivek (solutions/ops) so we can scope the proposal quickly.

High-level answer: yes — we can support an 8-GPU committed pool equivalent and offer a Premium SLA that includes:
- 99.9% availability for the dedicated pool
- 95th percentile tail latency target configurable per-route (we typically scope for 95th < 120ms for 512 tokens on x8-equivalent infra, will confirm after profiling)
- 30-minute incident acknowledgement and 2-hour mitigation window (per Premium Support playbook)

Next steps from our side:
1) Ben will share a commercial proposal with committed capacity, pricing, and a 6-month canary option with automatic conversion terms.
2) Vivek will run a short profiling plan (2–3 test prompts) against a mirror of your priority routes to validate the latency assumptions.
3) We'll provide a draft SLA and an Ops runbook for the canary plus an outline of legal redlines that impact SLAs/credits.

See attached—first draft SLA for review. Can you do 30 minutes on Thursday (Feb 12) to go over priority routes?

Attachments: redwood_premium_sla_draft_v1.docx (docx, 45KB)

Thanks,
Priya Natarajan
Account Director | Redwood Inference
priya_natarajan@redwood.ai

From: Elena Rivas <elena@starwave.ai>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 12 Feb 2026 08:37:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Renewal conversation — capacity + SLA requirements

Thanks, Priya — Thursday works. Quick notes before the call:
- Priority workloads are: real-time recommendation scoring (primary), search reranking (secondary), and nightly batch embeddings. The real-time path is the one that must meet the latency SLO.
- For the canary: we'd like a 6-week production pilot on a shadowed 25% of traffic, with a formal ops handoff and runbook signoff before conversion.
- SOC 2 evidence and data-retention/export controls will be needed by procurement before we sign a multi-year commitment.

Attaching a one-pager of priority endpoints.

Attachments: starwave_priority_paths.pdf (pdf, 85KB)

See you on the call.

Best,
Elena

---
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Rivas <elena@starwave.ai>
Cc: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 15 Feb 2026 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: Service upgrade proposal & mutual action plan (RW-2026-1782)

Elena — good call earlier. Per our discussion here's a concise proposal and next steps so procurement has what it needs.

Proposal highlights (summary):
- Committed throughput: equivalent to 8x A100-class GPUs (dedicated pool) — includes 10% monthly burst buffer.
- Premium Support add-on: 30-min incident ack, 2-hour mitigation SLA, designated support engineer, 24/7 on-call for P1s.
- Latency SLO: target 95th percentile < 120ms for 512-token real-time requests; we will validate with a profiling pass during the canary.
- Canary: 6-week pilot (25% shadow traffic), Ops runbook and rollback policy included.
- Term options: 12‑month commitment (baseline price), 24‑month commitment (5% discount), auto-convert after a successful canary.
- Renewal credit: 10% one-time credit applied to first month of the renewed term if signed within 30 days of pilot completion.

Commercials (high-level):
- Committed monthly fee: USD 72,000 (base committed capacity)
- Premium Support: USD 9,500 / month
- One-time onboarding & profiling fee: USD 18,000
- Proposed effective monthly (12-month): USD 99,500 after onboarding (examples and breakdown in attached PDF).

I've attached the proposal PDF and linked a mutual action plan in our HubSpot/Drive. Legal: the SLA doc attached is the working draft; procurement will likely request SOC 2 evidence and a standard security addendum — happy to push those items directly to your procurement contact.

Attachments: proposal_RW-2026-1782.pdf (pdf, 120KB)
Related links: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/1234567/RW-2026-1782, https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2B-starwave-renewal

If this looks good, we'll prepare a commercial term sheet + standard order form and route to legal.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.ai

---
From: Elena Rivas <elena@starwave.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@starwave.ai
Date: Tue, 17 Feb 2026 11:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Service upgrade proposal & mutual action plan (RW-2026-1782)

Ben / Priya — thank you, this is exactly the level of detail we needed. Procurement has two immediate asks before we move to an order form:

1) Final legal redlines — please send the latest SLA terms and the proposed security addendum so our legal team can do a quick pass.
2) SOC 2 Type II evidence & AICPA letter (or an equivalent attestation) — procurement will need this attached to the order.

We accept the 12-month baseline with the 6-week canary and auto-convert language, but we want the 10% renewal credit formalized in the order form. If Redwood can provide the SOC 2 evidence within five business days and the legal redlines within three, procurement will aim to sign the term sheet within two weeks.

I'll loop our procurement lead into the next thread (procurement@starwave.ai) and will share any internal PO timing.

Thanks — looking forward to the pilot.

Best,
Elena Rivas
Head of Platform
Starwave, Inc.
